technical_summary: Workload: RAG-style research portal with two-stage pipeline: ANN dense retrieval (embedding index) + lightweight sparse retrieval fallback + learned neural reranker for top-K reordering.
Scale: ~20M unique documents (PDFs, markdown, transcripts). Expect ~20M vectors; projected index size after 8-bit quantization ~60-120GB, depending on embedding dim.
Traffic profile: sustained 150 QPS during market hours with 600 QPS burst windows; spike tolerance required for earnings days.
Latency SLOs: first-pass retrieval (ANN) p50 <50ms, p95 <120ms; reranker end-to-end p99 <300ms. Goal: median end-to-end <120ms.
Cost targets: goal cost per query (end-to-end) < $0.002. Evaluate batching, prefix caching, KV warm pools, and quantized models to meet target.

Model preferences: prefer Redwood-verified embeddings (dense) but open to hybrid dense+sparse. Reranker: small-to-medium cross-encoder tuned to financial eval set; fallback to distilled model under load.
Indexing: planned nightly bulk ingest + streaming delta updates. Need sharded HNSW/FAISS with multi-region replicas and single-tenant GPU pools for deterministic tail latency.
Availability: dedicated capacity preferred for predictable latency; require VPC peering and customer KMS (HSM optional) for keys.
Observability: per-query token-level cost breakdown, per-route latency dashboards, and eval regression alerts tied to prompt set.
Acceptance metrics for POC: ingest 20M docs, 100-query eval >=8/10 relevance (analyst judgments), p99 rerank <300ms, residency + KMS validated in security review.
